notes: Primary experimental paper (not a review despite the broad title). Not retracted (is_retracted false; no retraction statement in the PDF). H2 isotherms measured at 77 K (volumetric, BELSORP 28SA, 0-0.1 MPa; 1.8 wt.% for A-SWCNT at 0.1 MPa) and 303 K (home-built high-pressure apparatus, 0-3.5 MPa). Carbon sorbents: HiPco SWCNT, nitric acid-treated SWCNT, phenolic-resin ACFs; zeolites are non-carbon but not needed. SWCNT/A-SWCNT contain 11 and 9 wt.% metal; uptake expressed exclusive of metal. Surface areas are alpha_s-plot micropore (Smicro) and external (Sext) areas from N2 at 77 K on the same samples; no BET or total area is reported. No statement that the uptake values were published before (ref. [10] is a prior report by other authors). Page images main-2 and main-3 checked against the text layer for Table 1 and Fig. 2 axes.
